Actual Article Body:
A new solution in your inbox every day.

Episode Description:

There’s a startup training dogs to detect cancer across seven types… and there’s over 90 percent accuracy across six hospitals.

This week Arielle and Karissa also cover a wildcat species science just got around to naming (local communities already had a name for it), bison reshaping a Mexican desert faster than anyone expected, and what Cambridge researchers found when they actually quantified how reading protects your brain.

Nominate a Local Changemaker (30 and under): https://us20.list-manage.com/survey?u=d2e7810fd2bcf24fb1144a7e2&id=6e0ab37520&e=28025b5010

If you have questions, comments, feedback, suggestions, or just want to say hi, send a message to: podcast@optimistdaily.com.

Theme and all original music by Marvin Lanes

Intro & Housekeeping

Karissa:

Hello everyone, I’m Karissa.

Arielle:

I’m Arielle.

Karissa:

And welcome back to The Optimist Daily’s weekly roundup.

Arielle:

Yes, it’s great to be back, as always. Um, is there anything fun, new, and exciting happening in your life, Karissa?

Karissa:

Hmm. It’s officially fall as of this week, so things are finally kind of back into routine. I don’t have as many weekend plans.

And last week, I mentioned wanting to take on some more sewing projects, and I’ve been doing that. I made a sunglasses case, so that’s new and exciting. Wow. But, what about you, Arielle?

Arielle:

Um… Oh, my dog is now, uh, scratching at the door. One second. Um, I don’t know if it’s fun or exciting, but it is new. I think my dog’s just getting a bit older.

Tinkerbell is not walking as quickly as before, and she sometimes has a limp, so- Oh … I’m gonna take her to the vet. I know. She’s turning nine next year, in January. So yeah, that’s just, it’s a part of life. But that’s been something new that I’ve been noticing.

Karissa:

Yeah, a new era for Tinkerbell. Oh, my cat is here.

Arielle:

Our pets are just, uh-

Karissa:

Y- yeah, trying to be guests on the podcast, of course, ’cause they’re just- Uh … so excited about all this positive news. Yeah. Uh- Oh, goodness … but before we go any further, we wanna remind you that all of these solutions are available in our free daily or weekly newsletter. So if you wanna sign up for that and get all of this positive news straight to your inbox, the link to do that is in the show notes.

Arielle:

If you prefer to get your news on socials, you can follow us @optimistdaily on basically everything except for X. There we are @OdeToOptimism. Uh, we love to hear from you. We love to read your comments, and if you engage with us, that is highly appreciated. But you can also reach us directly at podcast@optimistdaily.com.

There you can just shoot us an email if you have any comments, questions, or feedback.

Karissa:

We also wanna give a big shout-out to our Optimist Daily Emissaries, who are our financial supporters here and help us get all this positive solution news out to as many people as possible. If you wanna become an Emissary, the link to do that is also in the show notes.

And if you become an Emissary, you can have a shout-out right here on the podcast to anyone or anything that makes you optimistic. The link to do that should’ve been sent to you when you became an Emissary. We send out reminders every once in a while. But if you’re an Emissary and you need that link, let us know and we can send it over to you.

Arielle:

Another reason we would love to hear from you right now is that the nominations are still open for our annual Local Changemaker series. We do it every year in the run-up to Thanksgiving, and this year, we’re doing the whole series on Changemakers 3
